scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.build: npm run prisma:generate && npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.typecheck: npm run prisma:generate && npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.lint: npm run eslint && npm run typecheck && git diff --check
scripts.test:e2e:permissions: node scripts/require-env.cjs DATABASE_URL && playwright test tests/e2e/backend-permissions.spec.ts --project=chromium
